text.en:
1. This order may be cited as the Fees (Remission of Censorship Fees) Citation and
Order, 1966, and shall be deemed to have effect for the period Ist day SAP
of January, 1955 to 30th day of June, 1966.

2. The fees payable by a person for the services of the Board of Film Remission
Censors under items (1), (2), (3) and (4) of the Schedule to the "‘*
Cinematograph Films (Fees) Order, 1954 is hereby remitted for the L.N. 747/54.
period specified in paragraph 1 hereof.

Made this 3rd day of October, 1966.

[KHEDN. 2198; AG. 3008 /1.]

By Command,

Tun Dr IsMAIL BIN Dato' Haji ABDUL RAHMAN,
Minister of Home Affairs

P.U. 397.

MINISTERS OF THE FEDERAL GOVERNMENT (TRANSFER
OF FUNCTIONS) ORDINANCE, 1951
MINISTER OF NATIONAL AND RURAL DEVELOPMENT (TRANSFER OF
Functions) (No. 4) Order, 1966

In exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph (c) of sub-section (1)

of section 4 of the Ministers of the Federal Government (Transfer of 15 of 1951.
Functions) Ordinance, 1951, the Yang di-Pertuan Agong hereby makes

the following order:

SCHEDULE
MODIFICATIONS TO BE MADE TO THE FEES ORDINANCE, 1951
IN ITS APPLICATION TO THE BORNEO STATES
